interpretation: The initial six controls passed after shutdown, supporting host contention as a contributor to stalls. A subsequent focused run nevertheless reproduced an impact rejection and later timeouts. The metadata fault remains open; simulator shutdown did not fix it. The exact rejection branch is now known, but its operand state is not yet captured.
